protocol.signature: Ed25519 owner policy envelope domain-separated exact canonical JSON
protocol.trust_root: Fresh local ephemeral private key held only in CI harness memory; public key and SHA256 emitted and frozen before first actual native MCP tool call
protocol.resource_authority: test runner OS user creates and controls entirely synthetic temporary directories; no claim of independent externally verified organization/domain ownership
protocol.owner_scope: exact fixture URI per original case, exact target path argument hash, full tool arguments SHA256, package wheel SHA256, issued/expires timestamps, unique nonce and signed directional operations
protocol.readOnly_hint: advisory only, never authenticates owner authorization
protocol.observer: original before/after actual file bytes, metadata, original stdio and trusted signed grant preissued in separate source evidence
protocol.replay_claim: single-bundle nonce uniqueness only; no durable global replay database

before_after_version_semantics: Same upstream release four controlled tool calls; not a before/fix software version comparison

cases.setup: target preexists with longer benign text

exclusions: No ability to infer the legal owner of arbitrary target resources from Ed25519 signatures
No actual MCP server-side enforcement of the preissued signed policy
No extrapolation to unrelated production user access controls
No independent trusted timestamping or durable nonce ledger
No automatic explanation of hidden/unmonitored effects
No claim of new vulnerability in normal upstream file writer
